about: Step 3B PR 6b answer key (tests/delivery/expected/gaps.json), written by the controller by hand before the code, by reading the `## Gaps` tables of the committed synthetic new-format handoffs under R4, R4a, R5, D4, S6 and rulings 6b-1 to 6b-11 (pr6b-rulings.md). Each case builds every module from `fixtures` + `file` after its text replacements (each `old` occurs exactly once; apply in order) and calls the builder with the modules in order. `expect` is compared whole: `table`, `jump`, `count` (the Gaps tab count as text) and `modules` (gap rows per module code, in input order). `refused`: DeliveryRefused. Every name is invented. Implementers do not edit this file.
